# Theme packs (generated by `cargo xtask format-docs`; do not edit)

Files: `theme.ron` ([ThemeFile](#themefile)), `holes/<i>.png`, `holes/<i>.mask.png`, `green_ball.png`, `green_ball.mask.png`, `stones/<i>.png`, `misc/<i>.png`, `front_tile.png`, `back_tile.png`.

The theme authoring format: `theme.ron`, `holes/<i>.png` with `holes/<i>.mask.png`, `green_ball.png` with `green_ball.mask.png`, `stones/<i>.png`, `misc/<i>.png`, `front_tile.png` and `back_tile.png`.

A stamp (hole or green ball) is a meaning mask plus a paint layer; `compile_theme` writes OLX's colour-coded images back, so `olr-terrain` and the simulation read them unchanged (`docs/porting/olx-notes/asset-formats.md` §4).

<a id="themefile"></a>

## ThemeFile (`theme.ron`)

`theme.ron`: the theme's name and how many of each image it has.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | required | Shown in menus. |
| `notes` | string | `""` | Free text for authors; ignored by the game. |
| `holes` | integer | required | The hole stamps `holes/<i>.png` with `holes/<i>.mask.png`, `i` from 1 (OLX's `Hole1`…: stamp `i` is hole size `i - 1`), at most `MAX_HOLES` (16). |
| `stones` | integer | `0` | The images `stones/<i>.png`, `i` from 1, at most `MAX_THEME_IMAGES` (64): OLX's map-editor art, which the game does not read yet. |
| `misc` | integer | `0` | The images `misc/<i>.png`, as `stones`. |
| `green_ball` | boolean | `false` | Whether `green_ball.png` and `green_ball.mask.png` exist: the green dirt stamp. |
